eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 2:10 PM on AUG 25, 2023 Effective until 2:10 PM AUG 26, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office has ordered a mandatory evacuation for Memorial Church, Whittington, Ragle Road area due to wildfires. This notice affects all residents and you should evacuate now. The fire is currently moving in a North/Northwest direction. Evacuate the area immediately
